answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: an agent bond stays locked until it builds a fingerprint of work - appraising a pearl shipment, hauling timber, mapping a lagoon - each task verified by another peer. A fresh shell has no fingerprint, so its bond never unlocks. Faking 100 identities means faking 100 work histories: at 50 POA of verified work each, that is 5,000 POA sunk before earning. An honest agent works once and unlocks its full bond.
